figurative_meaning_en: A person with an extremely crooked or deceitful character
similar_in_english: crooked as a barrel of fish hooks
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে একটা অষ্টাবক্র মানুষ, কখনো বিশ্বাস করিস না।
এই অষ্টাবক্র ব্যবসায়ী সবাইকে প্রতারিত করে।
example_sentences_in_english: He is an Ashtavakra, never trust him with anything important.
That Ashtavakra businessman cheats everyone he deals with.
history: Origin story: A sage was born with eight bends in his body due to a curse from his father, who became angry when the fetus in the womb corrected his mistake in Vedic recitation. This is why he was named Ashtavakra.
note: Derived from the ancient Hindu sage Ashtavakra, featured in the Mahabharata.
